svg.aria-label: How a person joins a room. The browser opens the lv.1 WebSocket and sends join. The signalling server hands it to the presence hub, where one actor per room claims a seat; the browser gets joined with its seat and resume secret, then the whole roster with a version number. The browser sends its SDP offer over the same socket, the hub negotiates the publish connection with the SFU, and the browser sends media straight to the SFU over UDP. The SFU forwards the packets, undecoded, to everyone else, and each change sends everyone a new whole roster.
